Commentary.Commentary: Abbott and Shamsi were the hitmen for the Proteas. Abbott wasted no time at all in piling into the tourists and finshed with a 4- wicket haul. Shamsi was impressive in his brilliant spell in middle. Let's see how they go about the chase. Can Australia defend this? Stay tuned.

Australia's batsmen have been sent back to the dressing rooms in premature fashion and full credit for that goes to South Africa's bowlers. They have done a superb job in dictating the pace of the innings. Australia have just about managed to push to a below-par total thanks to respectable half-centuries from Marsh and Wade. Tremain also added some vital runs for the side.

OUT! That spells the end for Australia! Served on middle and off, Boland steps forward and appears to defend it with a straight bat. De Kock behind the stumps sees something there and begins appealing for LBW. The umpire disagrees but the Proteas decide to review it. The replays show that, surprise, surprise, the ball hit the pad first. Ball tracking confirms the dismissal as the ball was going on to hit the stumps plumb. AUSTRALIA BOWLED OUT FOR 167!
Boland has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on off, defended off the back foot.
Scott Boland is the last batsman in.

OUT! Tossed up on off,  Wade gets down on one knee and looks to sweep it but the ball turns in and passes under the bat's edge. It does on to hit Wade's pad and he freezes in place, staring at the umpire. There is a massive appeal from the bowler and the umpire, after a brief deliberation raises his finger. Wade knows he is the last recognised batsman and goes in for the review. The replays show that there was no edge on the ball and that it goes on to tick all the boxes. End of a good innings from Wade.
Aaron Phangiso comes in to bowl.

FOUR! Played very fine! Length ball outside off, Tremain gets an outside edge on it and the ball goes past the keeper for a boundary to third man.

SIX! Shortish ball on middle and off, Wade pulls it through square leg and the ball passes cleanly over the ropes for a maximum.

FOUR! Close shave! Fullish delivery, Wade lofts it over mid on. The ball flies just above the fielder and crosses the boundary.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, Wade goes after it but misses.
150 UP FOR AUSTRALIA! It has cost them 8 wickets but they finally make it. Served outside off, guided to third man with an angled bat for a single.
Shortish ball down the leg side, the batsman leaves it and the umpire signals a wide.

On the stumps, played to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Smashed! Full on off, Tremain charges forward and drives it hard down the ground. The umpire signals four runs.
Flighted down the leg side, defended from within the crease.
SIX! It's up and over! Tremain lets loose with that one. Tossed up on off, Tremain gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Tossed up on middle, Tremain presents a solid front foot defence.
Full on middle and leg, blocked with a straight bat off the front foot.
Drinks break...

SIX! Third time's the charm! Shortish delivery on middle and off, Wade pulls it over square leg. The ball skims over the ground and Behardien is in position to take it. However, the ball goes over his upraised arms for a maximum. Much needed runs for the Aussies.
Again! A replica of the previous ball, and the bat's outside edge is beaten again! Wade is in a great hurry for some reason!
BEATEN! Fullish ball outside off and angled away, Wade charges forward and looks to put it away. The crowd gasps as he misses and it goes to the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, played with an angled bat to third man for a single.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, punched through the off side.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, Wade comes bounding down the track and smashes it. Some good fielding at mid off stops the ball in its tracks but the batsmen pick up a single.
Wade plays a sweep shot to short fine leg. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on off, Wade looks to sweep the wrong ball. It is a bit too short and goes above the bat and just goes over the off stump.
Full on off, driven to mid off for a single.
Flatter length delivery around off, defended off the front foot. Shamsi is probing at the batsman's defenses.
Loopy ball on the stumps, Tremain puts in a good sweep to fine leg. A good save in the deep keeps it down to a couple.
JP Duminy comes in at short leg.
BEATEN! Wide! Pitched down the leg side, Tremain gets forward to defend it but the ball spins in and grazes his pads before going to the keeper. The umpire didn't catch that and signalled a wide.
Tossed up around off, swept through the leg side for a single.
Tad fuller around middle and leg, Tremain flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Hurls a length ball around off, Tremain strides forward and defends it well by covering the line of the ball.

OUT! Knocked him over! Length ball around off, it straightens a bit and Zampa is beaten all ends up as he looked to have a push at it tentatively. Abbott once again strike here by crashing the off stump, gets his fourth in the match.
FOUR! Full ball on off, driven through covers for a boundary. Easy pickings there for Zampa.
Similar ball outside off, Wade strides forward and pushes it to covers. End of a successful over there.

OUT! Shamsi strikes! Darts it fuller on middle and leg, it spins back in as Hastings strides forward to block it.  The ball goes on to hit the front pad. Shamsi turns around to appeal and to his delight the finger is raised in no time. The bowling change works again and Australia lose their seventh wicket.

OUT! Abbott gets his third wicket! Length ball outside off, Marsh without any footwork looks to drive that but gets a nick. de Kock takes a regulation catch. Marsh departs after doing a decent job with his fifty though his team would have liked him to bat further. Australia six down and the Proteas will look to clear the tail now.

Serves it on the pads, worked to short fine leg.

Bowls it full outside off, Marsh drives it through covers for single. Fifty up for Marsh.
Serves it a bit quicker through the air. Marsh stays back and plays it to the off side.

100 up for Australia! They have really pushed hard to stay on and it's all thanks to Marsh. Floated on leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball and Wad plays it straight to mid off.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
Close shave! Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Wade comes down the track to play and gets beaten. The keeper fumbles and misses a stumping chance.

Short ball outside off, Marsh pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. Rossouw puts in a dive to stop that ball but gets hit on his finger and fails to stop it. He looks in some pain there.
Full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.

South Africa get their fourth wicket. Australia, loses their skipper.

OUT! Pretorius gets a wicket too! Length ball around middle and off, it keeps low and Bailey on his back foot misses that inswinger and the appeals for an LBW are straightaway up. The umpire without any delay raises his dreaded finger. Australia, three down and they are surely sensing a trouble.
Hurls a length ball around middle and off, Bailey pushes it to covers.

OUT! Abbott strikes again! Length ball around middle and it nips back in. Warner resting on back foot tries to defend but it defeats him. The woodwork is disturbed and Warner has to go. Abbott is on fire as he has knocked both the Aussie openers. In spot of bother now, the visiting side.
Short ball on middle and leg, Warner looks to run it fine but gets a top edge to square leg for a single. Lucky as that ball fell in no man's land.
Length ball on middle and leg, David Warner defends it to the leg side.

OUT! Finch departs early! Length ball around off, it nips back in after pitching. Finch goes for a push through covers but misses the line of the ball completely. The ball goes on to hit the off stump and the gap between bat and pad did the trick. The Proteas are right on the money and the visiting side loses an early wicket here.
Length ball around middle and leg, Finch flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace. Aussies off the mark.
Starts with a short of a length ball outside off, Finch goes for a slash outside off gets an under edge and de Kock makes a brilliant save. Good cricket all-around.
The players and the umpires are out there in the middle. David Warner and Aaron Finch are the two Aussie openers. Kyle Abbott will start the bowling proceedings. Here we go.

South Africa are taking advantage of their series lead to rest several of their players - David Miller (injury), Imran Tahir, Dale Steyn and Kagiso Rabada are being rested to make way for Farhaan Behardien, Aaron Phangiso, Tabraiz Shamsi and Kyle Abbott.
Australia have made one change to their side - Daniel Worrall is replaced by Scott Boland.
TOSS - Australia win the toss and choose to bat.

The pitch is a slower one and is expected to help the spinners while the weather looks conducive to a day of cricket, with a bit of intermittent cloud cover. A lot will depend onn Australia's bowlers, with many of their more experienced pacers struck by injuries. South Africa too might rest Dale Steyn now that they have a 3-0 lead in the 5-match series. Once again, be prepared for an electric run fest as these two teams collide.

Hello and welcome to the 4th ODI between South Africa and Australia at Port Elizabeth. With the series in the bag for the Proteas, the Baggy Greens will be playing for pride. South Africa are riding high on a wave of confidence but Australia came close in the last match. A heroic knock from David Miller gave them the win but he will be sidelined due to a groin injury. It remains to be seen if Australia can win it this time around.
